document: Universal Mobile Control — Audited Batch Chronology
re_audit_note: Revision 12 re-audits the latest saved chronology without inventing new runtime success. Current runtime claims remain separated from source-confirmed and historical evidence.
source_rule: Only source-confirmed implementation facts are CONFIRMED; historical tests remain historical; runtime success requires fresh post-action UI verification.

confirmed.action_mode: OCR refresh every 3000 ms; post-action refresh after 400 ms

chronology.result: Current Java service, accessibility configuration, manifest, Gradle configuration and debug APK are represented in the audit evidence.
Window-content retrieval, screenshot capture and gesture capability are declared.
Screen data combines Accessibility screenshot, UI tree and Latin/Devanagari OCR.
Local HTTP bridge is 127.0.0.1:8765 with the recorded endpoints.
/screen is cached; /scan requests a new scan and may return before fresh OCR is ready. Fresh verification requires a subsequent /screen read.
Action Mode starts OCR refresh immediately and every 3000 ms, with a 400 ms post-action refresh. Manual scans can overlap this work.
Tap/swipe use GestureResultCallback with a dedicated UMC-GestureCallbacks HandlerThread and wait for callback completion.
Latest known runtime tests returned callback timeout. Dispatch acceptance or HTTP 200 is not treated as gesture success.

chronology.event: Back behavior separated from current-build proof
chronology.result: An earlier user test confirmed Back worked, but current-build installation and service provenance are not independently established.
The bridge can return HTTP 200 with an error JSON body. JSON status/message is authoritative for application-level outcome.

The APK exists with a recorded recent timestamp, but the file alone does not prove that this exact build is installed, running, or that Accessibility Service was restarted after configuration changes.
New ML Kit recognizers are reported as being created per scan. Preferred correction is long-lived recognizers reused across scans and closed during service destruction.
Action Mode and manual /scan can overlap screenshot/OCR work. Add a single-flight scan guard or queue before relying on high-frequency control.
No /home endpoint is present in the audited current Java bridge. Do not claim Home support until separately implemented and verified.
onAccessibilityEvent is empty in the audited implementation. If live cache invalidation is required, use accessibility events to invalidate or refresh cached state.
Earlier end-to-end native YouTube playback was documented, but gesture callback timeouts and unproven installed-build provenance prevent treating it as current proof.
Unverified claims were downgraded; source-confirmed implementation facts, historical passes and required corrections are explicitly separated.
This re-audit corrects chronology and evidence classification only. No new tap, swipe, Back, Home, OCR or YouTube runtime success is promoted without fresh verification evidence.

findings.finding: Tap/swipe callback timeout remains the main unresolved runtime defect.
findings.correction: Diagnose callback timeout on the active installed service; require callback completion plus fresh post-action UI verification.

findings.finding: HTTP 200 does not equal application success.
findings.correction: Inspect JSON status/message; later return appropriate HTTP error codes where practical.

findings.finding: Installed/running APK and restarted Accessibility Service are not proven.
findings.correction: After installation, disable/re-enable the Accessibility Service and verify /action/status plus a fresh /scan.

findings.finding: Scan work can overlap between Action Mode and manual /scan.
findings.correction: Implement a single-flight scan guard or queue.

findings.finding: ML Kit recognizers are recreated on each scan.
findings.correction: Reuse long-lived recognizers and close them in service destruction.
Do not expose or claim /home until implemented and verified.
Add cache invalidation/refresh from accessibility events if live UI state is required.

findings.finding: Historical YouTube success cannot serve as current-build proof.
findings.correction: Retest only after active APK/service provenance and gesture execution are proven.

findings.finding: Revision-12 has no fresh runtime evidence for gesture or app-control success.
findings.correction: Keep runtime status UNVERIFIED until a timestamped before/after screen and action result are captured from the active build.

verification_rule.verified: Fresh post-action screen proves the expected UI change

endpoint_truth_table./scan: starts a fresh scan; fresh result must be read separately
endpoint_truth_table./tap: not successful unless callback completion and post-action UI verification are obtained
endpoint_truth_table./swipe: not successful unless callback completion and post-action UI verification are obtained
endpoint_truth_table./back: global Back action; historical success exists, current build requires provenance-aware verification
endpoint_truth_table./type: focus/editable-node action; verify resulting text on a fresh scan

next_correction_priority: prove exact APK installation and Accessibility Service activation
use accessibility events for cache invalidation if live updates are required
retest historical YouTube flow on the verified current build

changes: Re-audited revision 11 chronology without promoting any unverified runtime claim.
